body:
JGit version is stale in Bazel distribution: `v4.0.1.201506240215-r`.
This version uses stale version of JSch library: `0.1.51`.

This library only contains weak cryptographic algorithms, that was recently removed by GitHub. See this announcement: [1].

Older gerrit versions were affected by this problem as well, see this discussion: [2].

* [1] https://githubengineering.com/crypto-removal-notice
* [2] https://groups.google.com/d/topic/repo-discuss/AMVDwTIeDJw/discussion
@davido : Thanks for commenting and for your commit! Is it ready for review?
@laszlocsomor I wasn't able to test it in my dev environment and was hoping to get verification feedback from Bazel CI against gerrit CL. Unfortunately the verification firehose doesn't seem to work?

Yes, we've been replacing our Jenkins-based CI with Buildkite -- [details are here](https://groups.google.com/d/msg/bazel-dev/dQ6_Twlm9Yc/vf9YC1FPDAAJ).

Could you please create a PR instead of a Gerrit code review? Since Buildkite doesn't support Gerrit, we can no longer trigger presubmits from Gerrit reviews, only from GitHub PRs.

> Could you please create a PR instead of a Gerrit code review?

Seriously, you are telling that me - Gerrit Code Review maintainer -  to stop using Gerrit and prefer GitHub instead? That pretty much sucks.

I'm sorry about that.

I also like the Gerrit UI more than the GitHub UI, alas it's not my decision.
Also, AFAIK there's no Buildkite / Gerrit integration. What can we do?

> Also, AFAIK there's no Buildkite integration for Gerrit.

It shouldn't be hard to create Gerrit integration with any system. But that's the problem for another day. I will upload GitHub PR later today.
@davido Thank you for the PR! So make my build successful without waiting for the PR and release, what should I do? Should I downgrade the bazel or build a new bazel from the the master?

@yifan-gu Two libraries used by Bazel are outdated. So, obviously, it wouldn't help to downgrade. Just apply my CL (fetch it from Gerrit) and build custom Bazel version from master with my CL applied should fix your problem.

In case you are not familiar with gerrit UI: here is the link to cherry-pick the CL:

```
git fetch https://bazel.googlesource.com/bazel refs/changes/10/43610/2 && git cherry-pick FETCH_HEAD
```
